subject: Interim payment rail and country tax harmonization
messages:
From: Clare O'Neill <clare.oneill@solara-health.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Billing cadence + VAT evidence for EU pilot (Solara Health)

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. A couple of follow-ups from finance as we scope the pilot:

- Solara will be billed from two legal entities (UK Ltd and DE GmbH). Finance needs clarity on whether Redwood can accept consolidated invoices at month-end or requires per-entity invoices for VAT reconciliation.
- We have an internal constraint: AP team needs Net45 for the first two months of the pilot, then revert to standard Net30 once VAT routing is confirmed. Any chance you can approve a temporary Net45 for August–September?
- Also attached is a short list of documents our tax advisor requested (VAT registration scans, proof of supply location). Can Redwood confirm which of these are required for you to remit without withholding?

We prefer to avoid multiple wire transfers per invoice; if there is a short-term way to provide a single consolidated invoice with a split remittance instruction for your accounting, that would be ideal.

I copied our tax consultant Ivan (cc'd) who can provide the certificates quickly.

Thanks — can we get confirmation by EOD Wednesday so procurement can process the PO?

Best,
Clare O'Neill
Head of Procurement — Solara Health
clare.oneill@solara-health.com
Attachments: VAT-requests-summary.pdf (pdf, 72KB)

--

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Clare O'Neill <clare.oneill@solara-health.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing cadence + VAT evidence for EU pilot (Solara Health)

Clare — thanks for the clear summary. Quick responses inline: 

1) Consolidated vs per-entity invoices
We can support a single consolidated invoice that contains a per-entity breakdown as line-item groups (example attached: Proposed-Invoice-Schedule.xlsx). That keeps payment rails consolidated while preserving VAT line items for your tax team.

2) Temporary Net45
We can provisionally accept Net45 for the first two billing cycles (Aug & Sep) on condition that:
- Solara supplies the VAT registration documents for each billed entity within five business days of the invoice date, and
- Your AP confirms a single settlement instruction (one transfer) with remittance metadata specifying split amounts for each legal entity.

If those two checkpoints are met, finance will log a temporary Net45 exception for DL-2026-4571. After two cycles we’ll automatically revert to Net30 unless either party requests an extension.

3) Withholding / tax evidence
To avoid any withholding, we need scanned VAT certificates and, where relevant, a brief statement of supply location (country of consumption) from you or Ivan. I attached a VAT-Certificate-Request-Template to make collection easier.

Next steps (my suggested timeline):
- Wed 26 Aug EOD: Solara shares VAT scans + single settlement routing.
- Thu 27 Aug: Redwood issues Provisional Invoice for Aug with Net45 flag.
- By Fri 28 Aug: AP and Finance confirm remittance metadata and PO processing.

If any of this is a blocker, flag it now and we can route to legal/finance for a quick escalation. I copied Kimberly and Marcus from Billing to keep them in the loop.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
Attachments: Proposed-Invoice-Schedule.xlsx, VAT-Certificate-Request-Template.pdf

From: Ivan Petrov <ivan.tax@meditax.co>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Clare O'Neill <clare.oneill@solara-health.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 08:33:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Billing cadence + VAT evidence for EU pilot (Solara Health)

Priyom / Clare — attaching the UK and DE VAT certs. A few clarifications from our side:

- The DE GmbH certificate lists the local VAT id and confirms intra-community supplies. For UK, note the company is still applying an electronic submission; we can provide a confirmation email from HMRC and the registration reference this afternoon.
- Solara prefers a single SWIFT/SEPA transfer per invoice. We will provide a remittance CSV with entity splits and GL codes.
- One ask: if Redwood processes a consolidated invoice with internal split lines, can you include the invoice-level VAT totals per entity in CSV form (header row + totals) so our AP can auto-apply to each legal ledger?

We attach: Solara_VAT_UK.pdf, Solara_VAT_DE.pdf and a sample remittance.csv.

Ivan Petrov
Senior Tax Consultant — Meditax Consulting
ivan.tax@meditax.co
Attachments: Solara_VAT_UK.pdf, Solara_VAT_DE.pdf, sample-remittance.csv

Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Billing cadence + VAT evidence for EU pilot (Solara Health) — internal next steps

Team — finalizing the temporary Net45 exception and settlement process for Solara. Summary and asks for Billing/Payments: 

Summary of agreed conditional terms:
- Exception: Net45 for Aug and Sep only (auto-reverts to Net30 on Oct invoice).
- Condition 1: Solara provides VAT certs for UK & DE (received from Ivan; attached in thread).
- Condition 2: Solara will send a single SEPA/SWIFT with remittance CSV that includes per-entity splits and GL codes.
- Redwood will issue a consolidated invoice that contains per-entity VAT totals and will also export a supplementary CSV with header row + totals for AP.

Action items (priority):
1) Kimberly — can you create a one-off billing exception in Zuora (or our Billing Control) for deal DL-2026-4571 to allow Net45 for two cycles and tag the invoice as "Consolidated - Split Remittance"? Please mark the exception to auto-expire after the Sep invoice.
2) Marcus — please add a CSV export template to the invoice payload (field: entity_vat_totals.csv). Use the attached Proposed-Invoice-Schedule.xlsx as the reference for column mapping.
3) I will confirm the PO number and sign the provisional commercial terms doc via DocuSign once both items 1 & 2 are in place.

Attachments on my side: Signed-Commercial-Terms-draft.docx (provisional).

If either of you foresee friction (tax rejects, payment processing limits for multi-ledger remits), escalate to Finance ops — I'd prefer we catch this before Thu when Solara expects the provisional invoice.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
